summary: Castor Maritime Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, attaching a press release reporting its financial results for Q1 2026. The release highlights net income of $69.2 million, driven by improved charter rates and unrealized gains from its equity portfolio. No special-situation corporate event (e.g., merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring) is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report. Since this is a foreign private issuer's 6-K, it is equivalent to a domestic Form 8-K for quarterly results. There are no deal terms or structural changes to note.
